label: Suggested SF Ref for an untagged row
description_nl: First rule whose pattern is found wins. A pattern starting 'label:' looks at the row's first words, 'heading:' at the heading it sits under ((?i) = any case; ' ?' = a space or none, so '40A (2) (b)' and '40a(2)(b)' both match). {itr} becomes the year's form (ITR3 or ITR5). 'number' gives each 3CD row its serial in sheet order; 'by_column' picks refs by which column titles under the heading hold a figure (accepted -> 31(a), repaid -> 31(b)). A label that is a date continues the rule of the row above. A suggestion is a mapping only once a person accepts it. Final accounts: under a Trading / P&L or Balance Sheet heading a row's words name its item ({itr} PL salaries, {itr} BS debtors); these rules come first and need the heading, so the IT statement's own rows are untouched.
